sloka: वृत्तज्ञो वृत्त संपन्नम् उदार बल विक्रमम् ।इमम् अपि अंगदम् वीरम् यौवराज्ये अभिषेचय ॥४-२६-१२॥
transliteration: vṛttajño vṛtta saṁpannam udāra bala vikramam ।imam api aṁgadam vīram yauvarājye abhiṣecaya ॥4-26-12॥

translations.english: 'O hero consecrate Angada as heirapparent since he deserves it as the eldest son of your brother, a noble soul and equal to you in prowess.
